overview.zh: Device Check 页面维护人工编码器端点，并展示 P4 当前 Manual/Auto/RAM 状态。图覆盖 raw 捕获、Release Rope 的破坏性机械准备、逐行写入及验证、全量清除和启动时恢复事务。Manual 数据是后续 Auto 标定与 feedback 控制的前置条件；“UI 显示 Saved/queued”分别只说明提交验证或事务受理，不证明后续控制已 READY。
overview.en: The Device Check page maintains manual encoder endpoints and displays current P4 Manual/Auto/RAM status. This graph covers raw capture, the destructive mechanical preparation in Release Rope, per-row write and verification, global clearing, and startup restore transactions. Manual data is a prerequisite for Auto calibration and feedback control; “Saved” or “queued” in the UI means verification or transaction acceptance, not that later control is READY.

zh.plain: Device Check 页围绕 21 个关节维护 Manual Min/Max 编码器端点。表格同时显示当前 raw、方向、Manual span、Auto 标定值、URDF 范围和 P4 RAM/JSON 提交状态；用户可捕获端点、逐行写入、清除或执行 Release Rope。
zh.condition: 手动端点编辑要求有可用编码器读数；写入只处理 dirty 行。Release Rope 和 Clear Manual 都要求用户在默认选中的 No 对话框中明确确认 Yes。
zh.effect: 每行把 raw encoder 值转换为 Manual Min/Max 输入；后台动作通过 backend 读写 P4 并回查结果。Release Rope 会单独在 worker thread 执行，完成信号再回到 UI。
zh.failure: raw 缺失时捕获按钮不写入；串口断开时 Release Rope 被阻止；写入的 ACK/readback/CRC/JSON 任一验证失败会显示失败结果。清除或释放操作有明确设备状态副作用。
zh.recovery: 先恢复有效的编码器反馈和 P4 串口。Manual 写入失败时确认哪些关节已完成再处理剩余项；Release Rope 后按提示重新做自动标定。
zh.difference: Device Check 是人工提供端点的设置流程；自动标定负责从运动/反馈建立 Auto 结果，Joint Channels 则选择控制范围。
zh.unknown: GUI 代码说明命令及返回校验，不证明当前硬件 raw、端点是否机械安全或最终标定质量。

en.plain: Device Check maintains Manual Min/Max encoder endpoints for 21 joints. Its table shows current raw value, direction, Manual span, Auto calibration values, URDF range, and P4 RAM/JSON commit state. Operators can capture endpoints, write dirty rows, clear them, or run Release Rope.
en.condition: Capturing an endpoint requires a usable encoder reading; writes apply only to dirty rows. Release Rope and Clear Manual both require explicit Yes in dialogs that default to No.
en.effect: Each row maps raw encoder readings to Manual Min/Max inputs. Background operations use backend to read/write P4 and verify the result. Release Rope runs on a worker thread and returns to the UI through a completion signal.
en.failure: Missing raw data blocks capture; a disconnected serial port blocks Release Rope; failed ACK/readback/CRC/JSON verification reports a failed write. Release and clear operations have real device-state side effects.
en.recovery: Restore valid encoder feedback and the P4 serial link first. After a failed write, check which joints completed before retrying; after Release Rope, perform automatic calibration as instructed.
en.difference: Device Check is for manually entered endpoints; automatic calibration derives Auto results from motion/feedback, while Joint Channels selects the control scope.
en.unknown: The GUI code describes commands and verification, not current hardware readings, mechanical safety of endpoints, or calibration quality.

zh.plain: `_capture_raw(joint, is_min)` copies the selected joint’s current raw sensor count into either Manual Min or Manual Max, then marks that row dirty so it can be written to P4.
zh.condition: `raw is None` means the cached reading is unavailable; otherwise the integer raw count can be captured. `is_min` chooses which endpoint field receives it.
zh.effect: The handler selects `_manual_min_spins[joint]` or `_manual_max_spins[joint]`, calls `setValue(int(raw))`, and `_mark_dirty(joint)` updates pending-edit tracking.
zh.failure: When `raw is None`, status says capture is blocked and the function returns without changing the endpoint. A valid capture changes the UI draft only; it is not yet persisted to P4.
zh.recovery: Wait for valid encoder telemetry and capture again. Then use Write Modified to send the edited endpoint and verify ACK/readback.
zh.difference: This is a local UI capture step, distinct from querying or committing Manual references to device storage.
zh.unknown: Whether the sampled pose is a safe or correct physical endpoint is an operator/hardware decision not proved by this method.

en.recovery: Confirm only when the mechanical situation is safe. After completion, inspect returned motor masks/message, run automatic calibration, and verify its result.
en.difference: Release Rope prepares mechanical/state conditions and moves hardware while invalidating derived calibration; an ordinary Manual write only saves human-entered endpoints.
